# Clay 3D

Soft sculpted forms and cheerful color with readable structure.

## Use

Use for onboarding, friendly learning activities, and approachable product explainers.

## Essential traits

- Soft sculpted corners
- Pastel decorative solids
- Warm welcoming space

## Typography

Rounded system sans-serif with strong headings.

## Layout and surfaces

Roomy soft panels, floating decorative solids, clear action order. Pillowy relief, rounded corners, and pastel clay shapes outside reading zones.

## Palette

- background: #fff0df
- surface: #fff8ef
- text: #43344a
- muted: #6d5b70
- accent: #79446e
- border: #c9a8c1

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Clay 3D to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Rounded system sans-serif with strong headings. Roomy soft panels, floating decorative solids, clear action order. Pillowy relief, rounded corners, and pastel clay shapes outside reading zones. Palette: background #fff0df, surface #fff8ef, text #43344a, muted #6d5b70, accent #79446e, border #c9a8c1. Essential traits: Soft sculpted corners; Pastel decorative solids; Warm welcoming space. Avoid: Low-contrast pastel text; Toy-like controls without labels; Decorations obscuring information. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
